items.text: Bid compliance: assemble the proposal as a single PDF, verify it meets the 20-page limit, and submit it via the procurement portal before 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC. Ensure the service goes live for students by the first day of spring enrollment on 2027-01-11.
items.basis: The instructions mandate the submission format, page limit, deadline, and live date. Portal reliability is assumed.

items.text: Signature audit and retention: maintain an audit record of every signature event, capturing signer identity, time, and document version, and store signed documents for ten years.
items.basis: The audit elements and the ten-year retention period are explicitly defined in the requirements.

items.text: Browser compatibility and reminders: support signing across current desktop and mobile browsers, and send an automated reminder to any signer who has not completed signing within 72 hours.
items.basis: Browser support and the 72-hour reminder timeframe are explicitly stated.

items.text: System integration and availability: integrate the service with the College's student records system using its existing REST API, and maintain 99.5% monthly availability excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.
items.basis: The integration method and availability metrics, along with maintenance notice periods, are specified.

questions.text: Should templates for the College's twelve most used forms be included, and what are their specific formats?
What is the migration scope and data volume for the signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28?
How should the optional on-premises deployment option be priced and architected?
What support channels and escalation paths are required to meet the one-hour response time for severity-one incidents at any time of day?
